name: Six Senses Kaplankaya
positioning: Aegean resort near Bodrum with private beaches, rooms stepped into the landscape like a Mediterranean village and a 10,000-square-meter spa
best_for: Wellness travelers wanting a large spa with hammams and fitness classes
Families wanting pool residences, private beaches and children's activities

facts.text: The resort's address is in Milas, in Mugla province.
Spa facilities include an indoor heated pool, hydrothermal areas and hammams.
Fitness classes include spinning, yoga and Pilates.
Wellness experts create a personalized program for each guest's needs.
Pool residences and villas are suited to families.
The resort offers a host of children's activities.
Cuisine is Aegean-inspired and sustainable, drawing on the region's harvest.
Local farmers supply organic products to the resort.
Activities range from water and beach activities to hiking and discovering culture and nature.

highlights.text: The spa covers 10,000 square meters and offers wellness programming.
Every guest has a view across the Aegean.
Guest rooms are stepped into the landscape like a Mediterranean village.
Archaeological sites within easy reach include two of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

considerations.text: The resort's address is in Milas, Mugla province, rather than Bodrum town.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a transfer from Bodrum city center.
